g.text: The instance lock: one F1R3Gaze at a time writes a profile
the file exists from now on
(the sticky bit keeps XDG cleaners away)
write pid, mode, start time, data root
Windows forbids reading a locked file; not synced,
since a crash ends the hold it records
The window, --headless and wallet commands that
write exit with status 1. Commands that only read
go on with the profile read-only.
The first process ends, however it ends
exit, crash or kill: the files close
both locks released by the kernel
No stale lock: the next start takes both.
lock files, and what holds after a crash
